Ensure the published reference identified by Elias Ford is addressed in the application, including any required citation or distinction in the specification or prosecution history.

Add the university option notice obligation to the IP docket. No non-U.S. filing may proceed until the 20-business-day notice has been sent to the university's technology-transfer office and the notice period has elapsed.
Require a technology-control plan to be established and documented before any foreign filing or foreign disclosure is authorized. Include the export classification in the patent approval packet.

Proceed with filing the nonprovisional patent application within the 30-day window before the provisional expires. Non-U.S. filings are held until both the university 20-business-day notice obligation is satisfied and the technology-control plan is in place.
